analysis.title: GS U.S. Industrials & Materials | 27 strategy | ACM | AVEX
key_insights: Industrials fell 190bps on 11/16, in line with the broader market. Materials fell 150bps. Beta was the leading factor on the downside, and staples and utilities held green.
Energy led the decline with crude down over 300bps (WTI $85, Brent $92). Airlines rose while data center related equities fell the most, with positioning cited ahead of the NVDA report this week.
Commercial aerospace was weak despite lower oil (DPC -7%, FTAI WWD -6%, ATI CRS -5%). The desk says questions about that weakness are circulating.
GXO rose 4% after setting 2027 and 2030 targets that were ahead on organic growth and margins.
US S&P futures were down 30bps pre-market, led lower by technology on fears over US AI export controls. KOSPI and TWSE fell another 230-260bps and Europe was down 70-80bps.
Fed speaker Williams reiterated a cautious, hawkish-leaning stance, saying policy must stay sufficiently restrictive to bring persistent inflation back to 2%. The 10-year was at 5.11%, off its highs.

Home Depot 3Q EPS was $3.86 vs consensus $3.84 on a 150bps top-line beat. Comps were +2.2% vs consensus +1.7%. The desk says the size of the upside was roughly expected and flags possible pushback on the narrower EPS guide.
Home Depot raised FY revenue growth to +4.5%, the top end of the prior range, and moved EPS guidance to the middle of the prior range because of modest gross margin downside.
ACM fiscal Q4 EBITDA was $358mm vs $354mm and EPS $1.63 vs $1.60. Revenue of $3.9bn missed the $4bn consensus. Backlog was $28bn, up 13% y/y, with a 1.1x book-to-burn.
ACM guided fiscal 2027 (September year end) EPS to $6.15-6.35 vs $6.18 consensus and EBITDA to $1.35-1.39bn, with consensus in the middle. The call was at 8am with a 7% implied move.
ESLT Q3 EPS was $3.70 vs $3.62 on revenue of $2.25bn in line, with EBIT of $233mm vs $227mm. Backlog rose modestly to $33bn.

From a GIR earnings callback, AVEX ended 3Q26 with funded backlog of ~$444mn, about $172mn (~39%) from Maritime Systems. A further $1.1bn of awarded contract ceiling is not yet funded, and ~$410mn of it is expected to convert to revenue in fiscal 2027.

AVEX says core unmanned (UAV) revenue has ramped through the year and now exceeds Ukraine-derived revenue. The company sees a growth framework for 2027 and beyond without additional Ukraine-related revenue.

AVEX's FY26 revenue outlook of $820-840mn implies core revenue of ~$440-460mn, about 2.6x FY25 core revenue of ~$176mn at the midpoint. The company says its successive guidance raises came from core revenue replacing EUCOM Deep Strike revenue faster than expected.

The note relays GS strategy's 2027 themes: AI trade moving from infrastructure to monetization beneficiaries, buyback aristocrats, Growth as a factor (Energy infrastructure and Transports named), and diversification through Health Care, parts of Staples and mid-caps.
Insider buying was noted at FPS (CEO and newly appointed CFO) and at CTVA (CEO).

GS strategy says Health Care and parts of Consumer Staples trade at discounted valuations to trend earnings and diversify an AI-heavy portfolio.

earnings_insights: HD 3Q: reported EPS $3.86 vs consensus $3.84 on a 150bps top-line beat. Comps +2.2% vs consensus +1.7%. Operating margins in line, gross margin a touch below. FY revenue growth raised to +4.5%, the top end of the prior range, and EPS guide moved to the middle of the prior range.

ACM fiscal Q4 (reported, basis not stated in the note): EBITDA $358mm vs consensus $354mm, EPS $1.63 vs consensus $1.60, revenue $3.9bn vs consensus $4bn. Backlog $28bn, up 13% y/y, book-to-burn 1.1x.
ACM fiscal 2027 guidance (September year end): EPS $6.15-6.35 vs consensus $6.18, EBITDA $1.35-1.39bn with consensus in the middle. Options implied a 7% move for the 8am call.
ESLT Q3 (reported, basis not stated): EPS $3.70 vs consensus $3.62, revenue $2.25bn in line, EBIT $233mm vs consensus $227mm. Backlog up modestly to $33bn.
ESLT announced a new $100mm share repurchase program (the note labels it ECG).

AVEX 3Q26 callback: funded backlog ~$444mn with ~$172mn from Maritime Systems. $1.1bn of awarded ceiling is unfunded, with ~$410mn expected to convert to revenue in FY27. FY26 revenue outlook $820-840mn.
GXO initiated 2027 and 2030 targets that were ahead on organic growth and margins.

Earnings still to come this week per the calendar: ESLT and VIK pre-market 11/17, ZIM pre-market and CPA and WWD post-market 11/18, MMS, ROAD and VVV pre-market and ESE and KEYS post-market 11/19. NVDA reports post close this week.
